title: Twelve Banners component diagram
description: Twelve Banners: a Godot 4 project exported for the browser and the desktop, and a Worker that serves both, behind icelander.net's sign-in and the role games:twelve-banners, to invited players only.

components.name: Twelve Banners
components.responsibility: One game: the Godot project, the page files and the Worker, built by build.mjs and deployed together with wrangler.

components.name: Godot project
components.responsibility: The game: rules and turn resolution (scripts/Game.gd), map generator, AI, the ENet lobby and command/event relay (scripts/Net.gd), the 3D world view, procedural models, camera, HUD and menu, with a headless self-test (godot/tests/selftest.gd) that checks the rules, lockstep between host and client, and a twelve-civilization game.

components.name: Page files
components.responsibility: The landing page (play in the browser, or download), the play page's stylesheet and boot script (the CSP allows no inline script), the icon and the headers.

components.name: Twelve Banners Worker
components.responsibility: Serves every file to signed-in holders of games:twelve-banners, sends visitors to sign in, shows others a not-invited page, and joins the parted engine and downloads.

components.name: icelander.net login service
components.responsibility: Who holds the site_session cookie, and their games: roles.

relationships.description: Exported by Godot (build.mjs) to dist/games/fresh/twelve-banners/play/ and to three desktop zips.
Copied into dist/ by build.mjs, the landing page filled in with the downloads' sizes.
Service binding ACCOUNTS, through vendor/icelander-auth: requireRole(games:twelve-banners) on every request but the stylesheet and the icon.
